name: Learning From Mistakes
overview: Scripture teaches that while believers may fall or make mistakes, God faithfully sustains and upholds them, enabling them to rise again with renewed strength and wisdom. The righteous are never abandoned, as the Lord strengthens and helps them, lifting those who are bowed down and encouraging humility over pride. Learning from mistakes involves trusting God’s sustaining power and embracing the wisdom that comes from acknowledging our weaknesses and depending on His righteousness.
